change: Verified catalog comparisons expose deterministic per-kind counts for added and removed models plus the before/after kind of changed models.

semantics.added: models introduced in the current catalog
semantics.removed: models present only in the previous catalog
semantics.changedBefore: changed models classified by their previous kind
semantics.changedAfter: changed models classified by their current kind
semantics.emptyKinds: omitted from driftByKind; unchanged and source-revision-only reports expose an empty object
